name: Seganserin
summary: Seganserin is a selective serotonin 5-HT2 receptor antagonist which was studied for the treatment of insomnia and anxiety but was never marketed. It acts as a dual serotonin 5-HT2A and 5-HT2C receptor antagonist. The drug blocks the head-twitch response induced by serotonin precursor 5-hydroxytryptophan (5-HTP) and the psychedelic drug mescaline in rodents.

It acts as a dual serotonin 5-HT2A and 5-HT2C receptor antagonist. The drug blocks the head-twitch response induced by serotonin precursor 5-hydroxytryptophan (5-HTP) and the psychedelic drug mescaline in rodents.

uses.text: Seganserin (INN, BAN; developmental code name R-56413) is a selective serotonin 5-HT2 receptor antagonist which was studied for the treatment of insomnia and anxiety but was never marketed. Seganserin reached phase 2 clinical trials prior to the discontinuation of its development.

fact.en: Its R code marks it as a Janssen compound. Blocking 5-HT2A receptors deepens slow-wave sleep, which is why several such drugs were tested for insomnia.
fact.zh: 它的 R 代號表示這是楊森藥廠的化合物。阻斷 5-HT2A 受體能加深慢波睡眠，因此有幾種這類藥物曾被試驗用於失眠。
